title: rbs report fragment
description: One operation's result, emitted by an engine and aggregated by the reporter.

engine.description: Toolchain engine, e.g. uv / dotnet / npm.

status.description: blocked = a required upstream operation failed, so this never ran.

findings.description: Individual actionable items behind the summary — the *which*, not the count.

location.description: file:line for a linter, pkg@range for an audit, test id for a test run.

rule.description: Lint rule id, advisory URL, etc.

severity.description: error / warning, or critical / high / moderate / low.
